title: elleanthus lindenii var. cymbibracteus
intro: Elleanthus lindenii var. cymbibracteus, commonly known as the 'Hairy Elleanthus', is a plant species belonging to the family Melastomataceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Elleanthus lindenii var. cymbibracteus are attributed to its ability to exhibit expectorant properties, helping to ease coughs and promote mucus secretion. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
